mapper.select: SELECT id, app_name, app_id, app_secret_ciphertext FROM feishu_app_config WHERE deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, app_name, app_id, app_secret_ciphertext FROM feishu_app_config WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feishu_app_config (app_name, app_id, app_secret_ciphertext, updated_by) VALUES (#{appName}, #{appId}, #{appSecretCiphertext}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_name, app_id, app_token, table_id, table_name, target_table_name, task_type, status, last_sync_time, created_at FROM feishu_sync_task WHERE deleted_at=0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, task_name, app_id, app_token, table_id, table_name, target_table_name, task_type, status, last_sync_time, created_at FROM feishu_sync_task WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feishu_sync_task (task_name, app_id, app_token, table_id, table_name, target_table_name, task_type, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{task.taskName}, #{task.appId}, #{task.appToken}, #{task.tableId}, #{task.tableName}, #{task.targetTableName}, #{task.taskType}, #{task.status}, #{actorId}, #{actorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE feishu_sync_task SET task_name=#{task.taskName}, app_id=#{task.appId}, app_token=#{task.appToken}, table_id=#{task.tableId}, table_name=#{task.tableName}, target_table_name=#{task.targetTableName}, task_type=#{task.taskType}, status=#{task.status}, updated_by=#{actorId} WHERE id=#{task.id} AND deleted_at=0
UPDATE feishu_sync_task SET status=#{status}, updated_by=#{actorId} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at=0
UPDATE feishu_sync_task SET deleted_at=#{deletedAt}, updated_by=#{actorId} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at=0
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, system_field_name, feishu_field_name, column_comment, data_type, is_required, is_split FROM feishu_field_mapping WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted_at=0 ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE feishu_field_mapping SET deleted_at=#{deletedAt} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted_at=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feishu_field_mapping (task_id, system_field_name, feishu_field_name, column_comment, data_type, is_required, is_split) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{systemFieldName}, #{feishuFieldName}, #{columnComment}, #{dataType}, #{isRequired}, #{isSplit})
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, total_count, success_count, fail_count, error_message, started_at, ended_at FROM feishu_sync_log WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted_at=0 ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feishu_sync_log (task_id, status, started_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT column_name AS columnName, column_comment AS columnComment FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name=#{tableName} ORDER BY ordinal_position
